question: What omission regarding mātṛkā worship is being warned against month after month?
premises: The address is to the beautiful-faced goddess.
The act in question is mātṛkā worship.
The omission is considered month after month.
inference: Failing to perform mātṛkā worship month after month is presented as a critical omission.
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, without having performed the worship of the mātṛkā, month after month...
